description: Research-only estimate of annual personal umbrella pricing bands, the inferred risk class, and per-factor impacts for directional pricing. Use this for price exploration, not when the shopper wants Coverage Cat to shop for or buy umbrella insurance.

antique_vehicles.description: How many collector or antique vehicles should be counted in the risk profile.

at_fault_accidents.description: Total at-fault accidents across all household drivers. Omitted counts as none; a high count can move the profile to specialized review or make it ineligible for instant pricing.

auto_count.description: How many cars, trucks, or SUVs are in the household auto profile.

drivers_over_70.description: Number of drivers in the household who are 70 or older.

drivers_under_22.description: Number of drivers in the household who are younger than 22.

jet_skis.description: Count of personal watercraft such as jet skis.

large_watercraft.description: Count of boats of any size; personal watercraft go under jet_skis.

motorcycles.description: How many motorcycles should be added to the total vehicle exposure.

moving_violations.description: Total moving violations across all household drivers. Omitted counts as none; a high count can move the profile to specialized review or make it ineligible for instant pricing.

property_count.description: How many residential properties the household owns or carries liability for.

zip.description: ZIP code for the household being priced.

name: umbrella_calculator

disclaimer.description: Notice that these figures are informational estimates, not binding quotes; relay it with the numbers.

estimate.description: Risk class and annual premium bands.

class.description: Risk class inferred from the household profile, such as `preferred` or `standard`.

prices.description: One annual premium band per umbrella limit available in the state.

coverage_millions.description: Umbrella limit in millions of dollars.

high.description: High end of the annual premium band.

low.description: Low end of the annual premium band.

umbrella_class.description: Class used for pricing; it adds `_with_youth` to a standard class when any driver is under 22.

estimate_unit.description: Unit of every price: `annual_premium_usd`, annual premium in US dollars.

factor_impacts.description: Household factors that moved the profile off the best (`preferred`) class; empty when none did.

impact.description: Class this factor alone puts the profile in.

value.description: Count the estimate used for this factor.

inputs.description: The household counts you sent, parsed to integers; omitted counts are left out.

title: Umbrella insurance calculator
